reading.title: How to Measure and Compare
reading.purpose: Learn how to measure, weigh, and compare things.
paras: You can measure length with a ruler. You can weigh a pumpkin on a scale. Try it with two sticks.
Then compare the numbers. If two lengths are equal, they are the same. Look for a pattern, like clap, stomp, clap, stomp.

qs.q: To weigh a pumpkin is to find out
qs.why: You weigh a pumpkin on a scale to find out how heavy it is.

qs.q: What can you use to measure length?
qs.why: The reading says you can measure length with a ruler.
A pattern repeats again and again, like clap, stomp, clap, stomp.
